news.t: PS Medico build 36 (19 Nov 2026): the app now talks to your own server. (1) Search anything the offline catalog does not know and the app automatically asks the online verified list of 12,600+ price-checked medicines - a found medicine opens a full page exactly like a catalog one: alternatives, clash checks and its verified price history. (2) A 'Price wrong? Report it' button on every medicine page sends the real shop price straight to the owner's private list. (3) Every medicine page can show its full verified price history (every published check, newest first). (4) Prices refresh themselves through the server whenever any copy is opened with internet - and new verified prices can go live without any upload.
